samples.title: Tư vấn chuyến thăm của bố mẹ người bạn
samples.prompt: Richard's parents will visit your hometown, arriving Tuesday 16th at 18:05 and leaving Monday 22nd at 14:45. Recommend a hotel; cover its sightseeing trips, room cost, breakfast inclusion and vegetarian restaurant dishes. Reply by email (120+ words).

Lịch gợi ý phải phù hợp giờ đến và rời đi.
Viết thân mật cho Richard; thông tin dịch vụ trong bài là giả định để luyện.

Hi Richard,

Thanks for your message. I'd be happy to help your parents plan their visit. I would recommend Green Garden Hotel near the town centre. It has a lift and is only a short walk from the river, so they would not need to take taxis everywhere.

samples.title: Giới thiệu người bạn sẽ ở nhờ
samples.prompt: Jane may host your friend An while An attends a summer course in London and looks for a flat. Tell Jane about An's character, interests and current occupation or studies. Write a friendly reply (120+ words).
requirementsVi: Giới thiệu tính cách bằng biểu hiện cụ thể.

Giúp Jane hình dung việc sống chung; không tự chuyển thành thư xin ở nhờ.

paragraphs.label: Lý do trả lời
paragraphs.text:
Hi Jane,

Thank you for your email. I'm glad you're considering letting An stay with your family. We've been friends since secondary school, so I know her quite well and think you would get along.
paragraphs.noteVi: Người viết giới thiệu bạn mình, không đóng vai An.

paragraphs.label: Tính cách và sở thích
paragraphs.text: An is friendly and considerate. When we shared a room on a college trip, she always kept her things tidy and asked before borrowing anything. She may seem a little quiet at first, but she becomes talkative once she knows people. As for her interests, she enjoys cooking Vietnamese dishes and cycling. I'm sure she'd be happy to cook a meal for your family.

samples.prompt: Riverside Hostel advertises a paid weekend receptionist position. Applicants should communicate in English and use a computer. Write to Ms Tran: explain your interest, give relevant experience, and state your working hours and interview availability. Write at least 120 words.

Tách giờ làm được với giờ có thể phỏng vấn.

Dear Ms Tran,

I am writing to apply for the weekend receptionist position at Riverside Hostel. I am a second-year tourism student and would like to gain practical experience helping visitors. Your hostel is close to my university, so I could travel to work easily and arrive on time.
paragraphs.noteVi: Động lực phù hợp một công việc cụ thể.

samples.title: Trả lời khách về tiền đặt phòng
samples.focus: Cancellation policy and a practical response
samples.prompt: You manage Lake View Guesthouse. Ms Brown cancelled six days before arrival and asks for a refund of her 500,000-dong deposit. Policy: cancellations at least five days ahead receive a full deposit refund. Reply with the decision, information needed and a processing time of three working days. Write 120+ words.
requirementsVi: Áp dụng đúng chính sách đã cho: đủ điều kiện hoàn toàn bộ.
Nêu số tiền và thông tin cần để chuyển khoản.
Giải thích thời điểm bắt đầu tính ba ngày làm việc.
samples.summaryVi: Áp dụng đúng chính sách đã cho: đủ điều kiện hoàn toàn bộ. → Nêu số tiền và thông tin cần để chuyển khoản. → Giải thích thời điểm bắt đầu tính ba ngày làm việc.

paragraphs.label: Xác nhận và quyết định
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your email. I have checked your booking and can confirm that you cancelled six days before your planned arrival. Our policy allows a full deposit refund when a guest cancels at least five days in advance, so we will return the full 500,000 dong to you.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không tự bịa lý do từ chối hoặc trừ phí trái đề.

Thank you for your email.

paragraphs.text: Could you please send us the account holder's name, bank name and account number for the transfer? Weekends and public holidays are not included in this period.

I am sorry that I damaged your camera during my trip last weekend. I put it on a low wall while looking for my phone, and accidentally knocked it onto the ground. The camera still takes pictures, but there is a crack across the screen. I should have kept it in its case.

samples.title: Từ chối sinh nhật và hẹn dịp khác
samples.focus: A warm refusal with a concrete alternative
samples.prompt: Your friend Mia invites you to her birthday dinner this Friday. You must take your mother to a medical appointment in another city. Thank Mia, explain why you cannot come, and suggest another time and activity to celebrate together. Write at least 120 words.
requirementsVi: Cảm ơn lời mời và từ chối rõ ràng.
Giải thích ngắn đúng lý do đề cho.
Hẹn thời gian và hoạt động thay thế cụ thể.
samples.summaryVi: Cảm ơn lời mời và từ chối rõ ràng. → Giải thích ngắn đúng lý do đề cho. → Hẹn thời gian và hoạt động thay thế cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Cảm ơn và từ chối
paragraphs.text:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for inviting me to your birthday dinner on Friday. It sounds like a lovely evening, and I was really looking forward to seeing everyone. Unfortunately, I won't be able to come because I need to take my mother to a medical appointment in another city that day.
paragraphs.noteVi: Từ chối nhẹ nhàng nhưng không mập mờ.

parts.text:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for inviting me to your birthday dinner on Friday. It sounds like a lovely evening, and I was really looking forward to seeing everyone. Unfortunately, I won't be able to come because I need to take my mother to a medical appointment in another city that day.

paragraphs.label: Giải thích và đề xuất
paragraphs.text: Her appointment is in the afternoon, and we probably won't get home until late. I don't want to promise that I'll make it and then keep you waiting. Would you be free on Sunday afternoon instead? We could have lunch at the little Italian restaurant near your office and go for a walk afterwards. I'd love to hear how your birthday evening went.
paragraphs.noteVi: Có ngày, thời gian tương đối và hoạt động thay thế.

parts.text: Her appointment is in the afternoon, and we probably won't get home until late. I don't want to promise that I'll make it and then keep you waiting. Would you be free on Sunday afternoon instead? We could have lunch at the little Italian restaurant near your office and go for a walk afterwards. I'd love to hear how your birthday evening went.

paragraphs.label: Hẹn phản hồi
paragraphs.text:
Lunch would be my treat, of course. Please let me know whether Sunday works for you, or suggest another day if you're busy. I hope you have a wonderful birthday with your family and friends.

All the best,
paragraphs.noteVi: Giữ giọng thân mật; không dùng văn hành chính.

samples.title: Cảm ơn gia đình đã đón tiếp
samples.focus: A specific memory and a return invitation
samples.prompt: You stayed with your friend Lucy's family for a week. Write to Lucy after returning home: thank the family, describe what you enjoyed most, and invite Lucy to visit you, suggesting a time and things to do. Write at least 120 words.
requirementsVi: Cảm ơn cả gia đình, nêu một kỷ niệm cụ thể.
Mời Lucy đến thăm, có thời gian và hoạt động.
Giữ nội dung là thư cảm ơn sau chuyến đi.
samples.summaryVi: Cảm ơn cả gia đình, nêu một kỷ niệm cụ thể. → Mời Lucy đến thăm, có thời gian và hoạt động. → Giữ nội dung là thư cảm ơn sau chuyến đi.

paragraphs.label: Đã về nhà và cảm ơn
paragraphs.text:
Hi Lucy,

I've arrived home safely, and I wanted to thank you and your family for such a wonderful week. Please tell your parents how much I appreciated their kindness. Having a comfortable room and someone to talk to each evening made me feel at home straight away.
paragraphs.noteVi: Một lời cảm ơn gắn với sự giúp đỡ thực tế.

parts.text:
Hi Lucy,

I've arrived home safely, and I wanted to thank you and your family for such a wonderful week. Please tell your parents how much I appreciated their kindness. Having a comfortable room and someone to talk to each evening made me feel at home straight away.

paragraphs.label: Kỷ niệm đáng nhớ
paragraphs.text: The best part was our bicycle ride to the lake. I loved stopping at the small bakery on the way and having lunch by the water. Your father was so patient when I couldn't keep up! I also enjoyed helping your mother cook dinner and learning how she makes her vegetable soup.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kỷ niệm cụ thể giúp thư tự nhiên, không dùng lời khen rỗng.

parts.text: The best part was our bicycle ride to the lake. I loved stopping at the small bakery on the way and having lunch by the water. Your father was so patient when I couldn't keep up! I also enjoyed helping your mother cook dinner and learning how she makes her vegetable soup.

I'd love you to visit me during the first week of August, when I'll be on holiday. You could stay in our spare room, and I could show you the old market and take you to the beach for a day. Please let me know what you think.

Best wishes,
paragraphs.noteVi: Thời gian, chỗ ở và hai hoạt động tạo lời mời khả thi.

samples.prompt: You organise a university careers evening on 20 September, 6–8 p.m. Invite Ms Le, a local hotel manager, to give a 20-minute talk about careers in hospitality followed by questions. Mention the audience, venue, travel support and a reply deadline of 5 September. Write 120+ words.

paragraphs.label: Lời mời và lý do
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Le,

I am writing to invite you to speak at our university careers evening on 20 September. The event will run from 6 to 8 p.m. in Hall B on the main campus. Around sixty final-year tourism students are expected to attend, and your experience managing a local hotel would be very useful to them.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đủ thời gian, nơi và đối tượng; lời mời có lý do.

We can provide a projector and arrange a taxi to collect you and take you home afterwards.
